map.顶空气积 = 包装总容积(mL) − 产品体积(mL)；初始氧量 = 顶空气积: Headspace volume = total package volume (mL) − product volume (mL); initial oxygen = headspace volume × initial oxygen concentration (%) ÷ 100; oxygen after storage = initial oxygen + oxygen transmission rate OTR (mL/(m²·day)) × area (m²) × days − oxygen consumed by the product; residual oxygen rate = oxygen after storage ÷ headspace volume × 100%. Food packaging usually needs a residual oxygen rate below 1%-2% to extend shelf life, and nitrogen flushing markedly lowers the initial oxygen concentration.
map.充气后顶空初始氧浓度 (%): Initial headspace oxygen concentration after flushing (%)
map.空气21%，充氮后通常降至 0.5-3%: Air is 21%; after nitrogen flushing it is usually brought down to 0.5-3%
map.铝箔≈0.5，EVOH≈0.5-5，PET≈50-100，PE≈2000+（典型: Aluminium foil about 0.5, EVOH 0.5-5, PET 50-100, PE over 2000 (typical values)
map.顶空气积 = 包装总容积 − 产品体积。初始残氧量 = 顶空气积 × 初始氧浓度: Headspace volume = total package volume − product volume. Initial residual oxygen = headspace volume × initial oxygen %. During storage, Fick's law gives the ingress as oxygen transferred ≈ OTR × area (m²) × days × (21% − internal oxygen %). Too much residual oxygen leads to fat oxidation and aerobic bacterial growth.

map.顶空气积 = 包装总容积 − 产品体积；初始氧 = 顶空气积 ×初始 O₂%；储: Headspace volume = total package volume − product volume; initial oxygen = headspace volume × initial O₂%; ingress during storage ≈ OTR×area×days×(21−internal O₂%)/100.
map.500 mL 包装、产品 400 mL：顶空 100 mL、初始残氧 2% →: For a 500 mL pack with 400 mL of product: 100 mL of headspace at 2% initial residual oxygen gives 2 mL of oxygen; with OTR=20, an area of 300 cm² and 30 days, about 3.4 mL permeates in, giving a residual oxygen concentration of about (2+3.4)/100×100%=5.4%, which is high and needs a stronger barrier or more thorough nitrogen flushing.
map.怎么降残氧？: How do I lower the residual oxygen?
map.提高充氮置换率、选用高阻隔（低 OTR）材料、减小顶空，并尽快封口。: Raise the nitrogen flush rate, choose high-barrier (low OTR) materials, shrink the headspace and seal as soon as possible.
map.残氧多高危险？: How high is residual oxygen dangerous?
map.含油/易氧化品残氧 <1% 最稳；>3% 氧化加速，需配合抗氧化剂或真空。: For oily or oxidation-prone products below 1% is safest; above 3% oxidation accelerates, so pair it with antioxidants or vacuum packing.
